multiTenantArchitecture.description: All 163+ APIs enforce organization-level data isolation
multiTenantArchitecture.implementation: fetchWithDrizzle() helper automatically scopes queries to user's organizationId
requirements: All Server Actions MUST validate organizationId exists
All INSERT operations MUST include organizationId field
All SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE operations MUST filter by organizationId using and()
All 44 database tables include organization_id column

authentication.serverActions: All Server Actions use fetchWithDrizzle() which validates Stack Auth session
authentication.restApis: REST API routes are public endpoints (no authentication required)
authentication.authorization: Role-based access control (RBAC) enforced at Server Action level

errorHandling.organizationValidation: if (!organizationId) throw new Error('Organization context required')
errorHandling.httpErrors: REST APIs return appropriate HTTP status codes (400, 500)
